system.description:
Effective when you are equipped with a [Two-Handed] weapon. You will gain + [POW mod] on the damage roll done for the round you declared [Standby]. 

(SR 2): When you are in the [Pre-Action] state, increase your [Dodge Check] by 1. 
(SR 3): When you declare [Standby], you instantly lose 1 [Hate].

A fighting style that uses a powerful blow with a large weapon. The power of the blow that is fired after building up power is second to none.
